instruction: Fix `parse_kv` so a value containing '=' is preserved (split on the first '=' only).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib.py b/parselib.py
--- a/parselib.py
+++ b/parselib.py
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@
             continue
         if "=" not in line:
             continue
-        key, value = line.split("=")
+        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
         result[key.strip()] = value.strip()
     return result
